BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to No. 1 Michael Burke Terrace, a charming 3-bedroom semi-detached residence presented in excellent condition throughout and ideally located close to all essential amenities. This bright and inviting home offers comfortable family living with beautifully maintained outdoor space and private parking to the front.
Upon arrival, you are greeted by a lovely paved driveway with attractive stone façade and steps leading to the front entrance. Inside, the accommodation is both warm and welcoming, featuring an entrance hall leading into a spacious open-plan kitchen/living area complete with a wood-burning stove, creating the perfect setting for family life and entertaining alike.
To the rear, the property enjoys beautifully landscaped gardens with a pergola seating area, ideal for outdoor dining and relaxation. A Steeltech shed provides excellent additional storage space.
Upstairs, the accommodation comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms together with a main family bathroom.
The property benefits from an excellent location with a bus stop just moments away and all local amenities including shops, schools and services within easy reach.
Constructed in 1970 and extending to approximately 71.56 sq.m. (770 sq.ft.), this home boasts a BER Rating of B3, offering energy-efficient living in a mature and convenient residential setting.

Key Features
•	3 Bedroom Semi-Detached Family Home
•	BER B3
•	Approx. 71.56 sq.m. / 770 sq.ft.
•	Constructed in 1970
•	Bright and spacious accommodation throughout
•	Open-plan kitchen/living area
•	Wood-burning stove
•	Landscaped rear garden with pergola
•	Steeltech shed to rear
•	Paved driveway with private parking
•	Attractive stone façade
•	Convenient location close to shops, schools & amenities
•	Bus stop within walking distance
